buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address AIR FORCE STATION VADODARA DARJIPURA VADODARA GUJARAT Pin-390022 . 2. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. No Deviation Policy Any deviation from the Technical Specifications, BOQ, approved makes, drawings, methodology, A TC, or Buyer Additional Terms shall render the bid liable for rejection without seeking any clarificat ion. 2. Mandatory Site Visit The bidder shall be deemed to have visited and inspected the site before submission of the bid. No claim regarding site conditions, measurements, accessibility, logistics, or additional cost shall be e ntertained after bid submission. 3. Verification of Credentials The Buyer reserves the right to verify any work order, completion certificate, invoice, client refere

nce, OEM authorization, or any other document submitted by the bidder. Submission of false, misl eading, or unverifiable information shall result in immediate rejection of the bid. 4. Approved Materials Only Only new, genuine, and approved materials strictly conforming to the bid specifications and releva nt BIS/IS standards shall be used. Any unauthorized substitution shall be treated as a material breach of contract. 5. Turnkey Responsibility The quoted price shall be deemed inclusive of complete turnkey execution including supply, transportation, loading, unloading, installation, testing, commissioning, labour, tools, machinery, c onsumables, finishing, cleaning, and handing over of the completed work. 6. Performance Obligation The successful bidder shall deploy adequate qualified manpower, technical supervisors, machinery , and equipment throughout the execution period. Lack of resources shall not be accepted as a rea son for delay. 7. Rejection During Execution The Buyer reserves the right to reject any material, workmanship, or completed portion of work fo und non-compliant with the tender specifications. The bidder shall replace or rectify the same imm ediately at its own cost without affecting the project schedule. 8. Warranty Responsibility Any defect including peeling, cracking, settlement, unevenness, colour variation, improper line ma rking, surface damage, or workmanship defects noticed during the warranty period shall be rectifie d or replaced by the bidder at no additional cost. 9. No Additional Claims No claim for additional payment, compensation, escalation, extension of time, or variation due to market fluctuations, labour shortages, transportation costs, taxes, or site conditions shall be enter tained after submission of the bid. 10. No Subcontracting The successful bidder shall not assign or subcontract the work, either wholly or partially, without prior written approval of the Buyer. Unauthorized subcontracting shall be treated as a breach of co ntract. 11. Qualified Site Engineer The successful bidder shall deploy a qualified Site Engineer/Supervisor at the site during the entire execution period. Failure to maintain adequate technical supervision may result in suspension of work or other contractual action. 12. Inspection Rights The Buyer reserves the right to conduct physical inspection of the bidder's office, warehouse, man ufacturing facility, service centre, or previously executed project sites before or after award of the contract.

13. Compliance with Laws & Standards The bidder shall comply with all applicable BIS/IS standards, labour laws, safety regulations, enviro nmental norms, and statutory requirements during execution. Any violation shall be solely the res ponsibility of the bidder. 14. Integrity Clause Any attempt by the bidder to influence the technical evaluation, financial evaluation, or procurement process, directly or indirectly, shall result in immediate rejection of the bid and may attract further action as per applicable Government procurement rules. 15. False Declaration Submission of forged, fabricated, altered, false, or misleading documents, declarations, certificate s, or information at any stage of the tender shall result in immediate rejection of the bid, forfeiture of applicable securities, cancellation of the contract (if awarded), and may lead to debarment/blac klisting as per Government procurement rules. 16. Technical Evaluation Committee Decision The decision of the Technical Evaluation Committee regarding technical compliance, document ve rification, product suitability, and bidder eligibility shall be final and binding on all bidders. No corr espondence or representation shall be entertained thereafter. 17. Buyer's Absolute Right The Buyer reserves the absolute right to accept, reject, cancel, modify, or annul the tender, wholly or partially, at any stage without assigning any reason. The Buyer's decision shall be final and bind ing on all bidders. . 4. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 2 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 5. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 6. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any.
